charge_port.notes: Estimated: BMW iX keeps CCS1 (InsideEVs: all current BMW EVs use CCS ports); 2026 iX assumed unchanged (no page for a 2026 NACS iX found; the i5 switched mid-2026).

supercharger_access.notes: Canada: Lectron Vortex Plus NACS-to-CCS adapter plus software update (from 2026-04-08).
US: Supercharging with a CCS-to-NACS adapter (Lectron) from the week of 2025-12-10 for i4/i5/i7/iX; 2026 cars need a software update.

wheels.notes: xDrive40 (Canada): P235/60R20 tires on both axles, so 20 in wheels; Guide Auto gives no wheel-diameter line. The Cars.com 2023 US xDrive50 (same 20 in) is consistent.
